limitations: Equal-weight quintiles, next-open entry and exit. Valuation (Eastmoney) and industry (Baostock) are retrospective vintages, not point-in-time; value results can be optimistic. Suspended or delisted holdings are valued at their last traded close. One-price limit-up entries are excluded; other limit and capacity effects are not modelled. Cost is a flat 0.15% per one-way trade on quintile turnover. No forward return reaches the sealed date.
